conversation_parts.body: Hi Bryn, I’m Elwenna from Ormsgill Cyber — we’re getting blocked trying to log into Keelwater again this morning. It’s showing ‘down’ but I think it’s on our end.
We’ve had a few false alarms lately where Keelwater appears down, but it’s actually our own customer network failure — maybe the sign-on provider or our VPN acting up again.
Internal note: Customer's sign-on issues are rooted in their own infrastructure, not Keelwater's platform. Please avoid attributing downtime to product failure.

Thanks for reaching out, Elwenna. I’ve checked our systems and everything’s running normally. The issue you’re seeing is likely due to your customer network failure — maybe a VPN or SSO provider hiccup?
That’s what I suspected — our IT team is looking into the customer network failure now. Sorry for the false alarm.
No problem at all — appreciate you flagging it. Let me know if you need help checking your integrations or roles while you sort it out.
Will do — thanks for the quick reply. We’ll circle back if the documents or payments tabs give us grief after the fix.
You’re welcome — and feel free to reach out anytime. We’re here to help with tasks, suppliers, or even policyholders if anything else comes up.
